events.summary: Fix only what code can fix: bump the indirect x/mod dependency (pulled in by github.com/google/go-licenses/v2, not by agent code) and add a top-level read-only permissions block to the two workflows that lacked one. Every job that publishes already declares its own job-level permissions, so the top-level default does not remove any grant. Not touched: the job-level contents: write grants (release-binaries, helm-release, release-manifest, release-bundle, update-changelog, dependabot-licenses commit) are required to create releases and push commits; branch protection, code-review, and the CII badge are repository settings, not workflow content.

Reproduced both findings locally before changing anything: go.mod pinned golang.org/x/mod v0.37.0 (indirect; 'go mod why -m' traces it to github.com/google/go-licenses/v2), and 'go list -m -versions' confirmed v0.40.0 is the current release matching the advisories' fixed version. The failing Image Scan job log on Dependabot PR #163 (run 34071322793) exits 1 from the Trivy image step at severity HIGH,CRITICAL. For the workflow alerts, an awk pass over ci.yaml and release.yaml showed no top-level 'permissions:' key while dependabot-licenses.yaml, e2e-airgap.yaml, agent-behavior.yml and scorecard.yml all had one, matching Scorecard's per-file findings exactly.

go get golang.org/x/mod@v0.40.0 && go mod tidy (also moved x/net v0.58.0, x/text v0.41.0, x/tools v0.49.0 as transitive minimums). Added 'permissions: contents: read' at the top level of ci.yaml and release.yaml with a comment explaining that publishing jobs widen it per job.

go build ./... clean; gofmt -l . empty; go vet ./... clean; go test ./... all 15 packages pass; scripts/ci/check-mutable-inputs.py passes for the three workflows; PyYAML parses both edited workflows; actionlint reports only the two pre-existing shellcheck style notes (same count on main); local 'trivy fs --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL .' reports 0 findings for go.mod. NOTE: this local pass missed the CI License Check, which failed on run 34071794792 (THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md stale after the x/net and x/text bumps) -- see e4b.

events.summary: Independent (Opus) review of e7c6ed1 returned FAIL: CI License Check on run 34071794792 reported THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md stale because the go mod tidy fallout (x/net v0.58.0, x/text v0.41.0) was not reflected in the manifest. Fixed by running `make license` and committing the regenerated file. Permissions audit and go.mod sanity were clean.

CI on 8b1949a: every check green except Image Scan (run 34072002382). The SARIF uploaded to code scanning for refs/pull/164/merge lists ~50 HIGH findings, all util-linux 2.42.1-r0 subpackages (CVE-2026-53612..53614, 76642, 78408..78410; fixed 2.42.3-r0/r1), created 2026-09-07T00:57Z -- i.e. new advisories, unrelated to the x/mod bump. main's last Image Scan (2026-09-05) passed.

Alpine v3.24 main APKINDEX already carries util-linux 2.42.3-r1 and secdb maps the CVEs to 2.42.3-r0, so `apk upgrade` should have fixed it. The Image Build log shows the runtime stage's `RUN apk upgrade && apk add ...` layer as `#23 CACHED` for all three platforms: the GHA BuildKit cache (cache-from: type=gha) replayed the layer built before the advisory, so the Dockerfile's #150 rationale (upgrade base packages at build time) was silently defeated. Locally, `docker buildx build --target runtime --no-cache-filter runtime` re-ran the layer and produced util-linux 2.42.3-r1.

Named the runtime stage (`AS runtime`) in Dockerfile and added `no-cache-filters: runtime` to the three docker/build-push-action steps that use cache-from: type=gha (ci.yaml image-build multi-arch + amd64 rebuild, release.yaml build-and-push). The Go builder stage stays cached; only the small apk/COPY stage re-executes each build. Input name verified against build-push-action v7.3.0 action.yml (plural `no-cache-filters`).

PyYAML parses both workflows; check-mutable-inputs passes for 3 files; actionlint reports only the 2 pre-existing shellcheck notes; local linux/amd64 build of the runtime stage on colima: apk layer re-ran, util-linux/libblkid/libmount 2.42.3-r1, `trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed` reports 0 for the alpine OS layer and the Go binary.
